selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific class label and distinguish from similar spherical objects (e.g., cricket ball, softball).
To verify the legibility and structural integrity of the printed logos and handwritten signatures, which are common failure points in AI generation.
To ensure the red stitching is physically embedded in the leather and not floating or bleeding into the white background.
